blocks.text: Specialist hiring, recruitment technology and delivery teams designed to support projects from mobilisation through steady-state operations.
People who can deliver on day one
Specialist recruitment, training and deployment supported by intelligent workforce platforms.

RabbiT is Purview's agentic AI recruitment platform. It calls, qualifies and schedules every applicant in their own language (30+ languages), scores every conversation against the role and keeps the whole pipeline on one board. It is how we staff our own 2,500-person workforce, and it is available to clients.
